name: The Royal Canal Way
description_md:
The Royal Canal Way is a waymarked hiking route in IE that spans 147.8 km. This national waymarked hiking network trail is signposted as RCW and requires about 37 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is classified as hard due to the distance and the 136 m of ascent and 174 m of descent. It passes Croke Park within 100 m. The trail also passes Dublin within 1300 m and Aviva Stadium within 1600 m.
